entities.name: Khrad
entities.description: A boastful warrior prince of the Telu-Set on Muraganda who wields the Star-Sword and is sent to slay the sorcerer Amarth-Tel.

entities.name: Grazak
entities.description: Khrad's raptor companion, who grows huge when fed mana pearls.

entities.name: King Khal
entities.description: The ruler of the Telu-Set and Khrad's father, who gives his son the Star-Sword and mana pearls.

entities.name: Amarth-Tel
aliases: ley mage of the Tarry Spire
entities.description: An arrogant ley mage who captured an alien vehicle and lives in the Tarry Spire.

entities.name: Nathala
entities.description: A druid-trained pearl diver of Telu'Ahn who spies on the racers, steals the vehicle's key and drives off with Khrad.

entities.name: Chatal
entities.description: A Fang Druid, Nathala's mentor, who gives Khrad a fire amulet and counsels him that the world is larger than he knows.

entities.name: Harl
entities.description: A wanderer scribe who brings King Khal three pearls of distilled mana.

entities.name: Tar Ooze
entities.description: A mammoth tar ooze given shape by skeletons and bones that serves Amarth-Tel.

entities.name: Telu-Set
entities.description: The Muragandan people of Mon'Telu, trained to hunt mages and wary of magic.

entities.name: Fang Druids
entities.description: Isolationist ape recluses and soothsayers of Muraganda.

entities.name: Mon'Telu
entities.description: The central stronghold of the Telu-Set.

entities.name: The Tarry Spire
entities.description: Amarth-Tel's bone-and-tar tower at the edge of Kalaka's Scar where leylines bunch.

entities.name: Kalaka's Scar
entities.description: A region of moon craters filled with viscid oil near the Tarry Spire.

entities.name: Telu'Ahn
entities.description: A coastal land in the Coral Canyons, home of Nathala.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: A plane of teeming life, leylines and tectonic wrath.

entities.name: Star-Sword
entities.description: The Telu-Set's only pure-steel blade, from sky-fallen ore, which can cut even souls.

entities.name: Fire amulet
entities.description: A saw-toothed metal chit on a ring with a furry token, actually the key that starts the alien vehicle's engine.

entities.name: The Vehicle
entities.description: An alien steel racing vehicle with a flaming crocodilian look, called a beast, relic and vehicle by different people.

entities.name: Mana pearls
entities.description: Three pearls of distilled mana from the emerald leyline that make Grazak grow huge.

entities.name: Momotaxos
entities.description: A being in whose burning blood the Star-Sword was forged.

entities.name: Endriders
entities.description: The racers whose vehicle Nathala identifies.

events.summary: Khrad and Grazak leap into a devastated clearing full of wrecked metal.
events.quote: Khrad roared and leapt into the clearing, Star-Sword brandished overhead.

events.summary: Masked raiders burst from the slag and attack Khrad and Grazak.
events.quote: A mob of bug-eyed figures swarmed from underneath the slag like maggots bursting from a ripened corpse.

events.summary: Khrad halves a giant's club with the Star-Sword.
events.quote: Khrad halved the weapon with a mighty blow, showering them both in sparks.

events.summary: Khrad feeds Grazak a mana pearl, making him giant.
events.quote: Grazak's form expanded—doubling, then tripling.

events.summary: Khrad kills a smoke-spitting marauder mage by feel after being blinded.
events.quote: The Star-Sword found the mage's throat.

events.summary: Grazak finds two deep grooves leading away from the clearing.
events.quote: two grooves a handsbreadth across and a stride apart, dug into the jungle floor

events.summary: Flashback: in Mon'Telu a root oracle warns that monsters from a far-off realm have invaded and that Amarth-Tel might seize one.
events.quote: Monsters beyond understanding have surged into our world, agents of some far-off realm.

events.summary: Flashback: King Khal decides the sorcerer Amarth-Tel must die.
events.quote: The sorcerer must die.

events.summary: Flashback: Khrad volunteers to hunt Amarth-Tel.
events.quote: None can match your might but me.

events.summary: Flashback: King Khal gives Khrad the Star-Sword as champion.
events.quote: As our champion, it is your duty to wield the Star-Sword, sharpest of all blades.

events.summary: Flashback: King Khal secretly gives Khrad three mana pearls via the wanderer scribe Harl.
events.quote: Three pearls of distilled mana, gathered from the emerald leyline, so that Grazak's claws may rend ever more colossal foes.

events.summary: Khrad feeds Grazak the second pearl and rides him after the shouting Amarth-Tel.
events.quote: Khrad pulled the second mana pearl from his pouch and fed it to Grazak.

events.summary: Khrad finds Amarth-Tel standing on a steel-and-fire beast pulled by a tar ooze.
events.quote: Amarth-Tel, wrapped in oily vestments, stood atop a beast of steel and fire, dragged forth by a massive tar-black ooze.

events.summary: Khrad sees a shackled girl in the vehicle's hollow and is distracted.
events.quote: She sat shackled in the creature's hollow, bound in Amarth-Tel's tarry cord.

events.summary: Amarth-Tel's ooze flings Khrad away and the beast escapes.
events.quote: A lashing oily tendril surged and sent the prince aloft.

events.summary: The Fang Druid Chatal appears and urges Khrad to continue against Amarth-Tel.
events.quote: I am called Chatal.

events.summary: Chatal tells Khrad that the world is larger than he realizes and urges him to reforge himself.
events.quote: The world is larger than you realize, Prince of Telu.

events.summary: Chatal gives Khrad a fire amulet that grants mastery over the vehicle.
events.quote: If used correctly, it will grant mastery over the beast, allowing communion between machine and man.

events.summary: Khrad and Grazak reach the Tarry Spire at the edge of Kalaka's Scar.
events.quote: Upon its edge stood the Tarry Spire, a jagged shadow slashed against the sky.

events.summary: Grazak breaks the spire's rib-cage door and Khrad rides in, challenging Amarth-Tel.
events.quote: The Tarry Spire's door was bound by bolstered ribcage bars. They splintered under Grazak's talons.

events.summary: A mammoth bone-and-tar ooze rises and attacks.
events.quote: The mammoth ooze expanded, creeping jelly given form by ancient skeletons.

events.summary: Khrad kills the ooze by stabbing its central skull's eye.
events.quote: The Star-Sword pierced the ooze's eye.

events.summary: Khrad frees Nathala from her cell.
events.quote: One strike and the bars were sundered.

events.summary: The freed girl names herself Nathala, a pearl diver of Telu'Ahn.
events.quote: I am called Nathala, once a pearl diver of Telu'Ahn.

events.summary: Khrad leaves Grazak with Nathala and goes to fight Amarth-Tel after she hugs him for luck.
events.quote: the prince of Mon'Telu summited the Tarry Spire to face his foe alone.

events.summary: Nathala reveals she is druid-trained and has been spying on the racers for Chatal.
events.quote: I'm druid-trained, if your Khrad had thought to ask.

events.summary: Nathala shows she took the fire amulet, which is the vehicle's ignition key.
events.quote: The racers—Endriders, they call themselves—called it an ignition key.

events.summary: Nathala declares the vehicle hers to take and study for her people.
events.quote: The vehicle is mine to take.

events.summary: Khrad and Amarth-Tel duel on the rooftop in a storm.
events.quote: You come too late, barbarian!

events.summary: Nathala starts the vehicle with the ignition key.
events.quote: With Grazak sat beside, she plunged the key into its port and twisted.

events.summary: The vehicle runs over and kills Amarth-Tel.
events.quote: The sorcerer's body vanished beneath the vehicle's tread, ground into the Tarry Spire's muck.

events.summary: Nathala drives down the collapsing spire and Khrad climbs in.
events.quote: The vehicle roared as it hurtled down the falling spire.

events.summary: Nathala throws Khrad's earlier words back at him, telling him to flee home.
events.quote: Use this opportunity to flee back to your home.

events.summary: Khrad humbly apologizes for his arrogance and asks to learn about the vehicle.
events.quote: I have been a fool.

events.summary: Nathala lets Khrad tag along on condition that she drives.
events.quote: All right. You can tag along, on one condition.

events.summary: The three drive off into the horizon together.
events.quote: Together, paragons of Muraganda, they drove into the infinite horizon.

relations.quote: I am Khrad, son of Khal.
he was kin, and mighty besides!
King Khal, ruler of the Telu-Set

relations.note: He tasked her to watch the racers.
relations.quote: My mentor Chatal tasked me with their surveillance
A Fang Druid, vaunted recluses and soothsayers.

relations.note: She drives the vehicle over him.
relations.quote: The sorcerer's body vanished beneath the vehicle's tread
Maybe my pet will slake your thirst?
